title: One in five customers drives 59% of revenue: our six customer segments for 2026
subtitle: A refreshed segmentation of 2.3M active customers, built on recency, frequency, spend, category mix and channel. It replaces the 2023 model and is now available as a field in the warehouse and in Braze.
summary: We rebuilt our customer segmentation with k-means on RFM, category mix and channel, which gives six named segments covering 2.3M active customers. Loyal Members and Nest Builders are 26% of customers but 59% of revenue. The segments are stable (ARI 0.87) and are now available in the warehouse and Braze for targeting.
key_findings: Loyal Members (14% of customers) and Nest Builders (12%) generate 59% of trailing-12-month revenue.
One-and-Done buyers are 25% of customers but 4% of revenue, and 31% of their orders come through marketplaces.
Big-Ticket Planners are a new segment: 6% of customers, 15% of revenue, AOV $601, 71% of spend on furniture.
Next-6-month purchase rates range from 91% (Loyal Members) to 17% (One-and-Done) in a backtest.
About 52k non-member Loyal Members already shop like Pine+ members and are the best membership prospects.
